correctness.rationale: For the 16-vertex four-cube, induced subsets must be both cycle-free and of maximum induced degree at most two. Independent full 2^16 subset enumeration gave exactly 14,910 nonempty faces, matching published face vector. The vertex-stage 7,383-pair matching is acyclic on all 85,424 Hasse incidences, with one critical 0-cell, seven 5-cells and 136 6-cells. Independently computed exact signed integral 7×136 Morse differential has the stated 7×7 minor determinant −1. Hurewicz identifies 6-cell attachments to ∨7 S5 with degree vectors, and the unimodular block cancels them, leaving ∨129 S6. One graph and stage only; no family extrapolation.
